title: NoCoralDecay
description: Adds a doCoralDecay gamerule, letting players stop live coral from dying when out of water. Set /gamerule doCoralDecay false to preserve coral blocks, plants, and fans.
body:
No Coral Decay is a small Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds a real gamerule for controlling coral decay outside of water.

By default, Minecraft turns live coral into dead coral when it is placed without water nearby. This mod lets server owners and players disable that behavior with:

`/gamerule doCoralDecay false`

When the gamerule is set to false, live coral blocks, coral plants, floor coral fans, and wall coral fans will stay alive even when they are out of water. When the gamerule is set back to true, coral decay works normally again.

The gamerule defaults to true, so installing the mod does not change vanilla behavior unless you choose to disable coral decay.

Requested by VAN.
